messages:
recruiter-alyssa: Heads up — candidate (R. Singh) just messaged: morning daycare closed unexpectedly, cant get to office until ~3pm. They're open to remote interviews but asked if we have a lactation room and whether we can start interviews later in the afternoon instead. Also asked about a quiet space for pumping and private room for a quick break.

maya-peopleops: Sorry to hear that — we can pivot. Remote fallback is available. We also have a lactation room (Room L1) and can reserve a private quiet room. If you want to shift panels, what is the earliest time the hiring team can start? @kevin-hiringmgr @tara-panel

kevin-hiringmgr: I can push my slot to 3:30pm, but we have 2 more interviewers who prefer earlier. If it's easier to keep today and go remote for the early slots, I'm fine. Could we also ensure the coding exercise still works remotely (pairing tool + shared editor)?

tara-panel: I have flexibility after 2pm. I can host the shared editor (CodePair) and screen-share if needed. If we delay whole loop, I'm okay starting at 3:30.

sam-it: Loaner kit available if candidate prefers to come later: MacBook w/ charger + HDMI dongle. I can also add noise-cancelling headset. Label: LOANER-3156. We'll sanitize and put it at reception for pickup.

recruiter-alyssa: Candidate prefers remote but asked if we could cover rideshare if they need to get here later. Also asked whether we can provide an interpreter — they communicate primarily in Punjabi and mentioned they'd be comfortable in English but asked if one is available for clarifying role questions.

maya-peopleops: We have language support vendors; arranging an on-call interpreter for Punjabi may take a bit. For same-day, remote interpreted session via vendor is possible — would the panel be comfortable? It would be a three-way call (interpreter joins Zoom).

kevin-hiringmgr: That's fine. If the interpreter can join remote, let's do it for the first screening. If candidate comes in person later, we can switch.

facilities-bot: Lactation Room L1 reserved 13:00-17:00. Quiet Room 2A reserved 14:00-16:00 as backup. Reception will hold LOANER-3156 starting at 14:30. Parking voucher reserved (if candidate drives) up to $40.

security-bot: Temp guest badge created; pickup instructions emailed to candidate. If candidate arrives after hours, let us know and we can extend access window.

recruiting-bot: Note for Greenhouse: add "language-support" tag and "lactation-room-provided" to candidate record; note LOANER-3156 issued pending pickup.

maya-peopleops: Reimbursement process: candidate can submit receipts to people-ops@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Expense - Singh". We'll fast-track. Also prepping vendor interpreter now; ETA confirmation ~20-30 mins.

recruiter-alyssa: I DM'ed candidate with Zoom link + lactation room details and offered the loaner pickup window 14:30-15:00 if needed. Candidate prefers remote test at 10am and will confirm interpreter after I check with them. Will update here after they reply.

kevin-hiringmgr: Thanks. If candidate confirms interpreter, please share vendor name and dial-in so the panel can join.

recruiter-alyssa: Update @channel — candidate confirmed remote at 10am and requests interpreter for first 20 minutes. They've accepted LOANER-3156 pickup later if needed. I'll follow up after the 10am check-in.
